name: Calm Breeze by Dondre Green
recipeMemo:
Comments from the Creator
The Calm Breeze recipe adds a gentle, timeless quality to your images with its green and yellow hues, enhancing the emotional depth of the moment. It’s versatile across various lighting conditions, from bright daylight to low-light scenes. Ideal for creating a modern, stylish aesthetic to your portraits, this recipe is perfect for capturing your subject against a white backdrop, emphasizing vibrant green foliage, or bringing warmth to night shots.
